method: read-only inspection of data/walkforward.db (file:...?mode=ro) and the frozen Dataset B store. No writes, no hypothesis execution, no return statistics.
headline_finding: The binding constraint is NOT absence of raw data. Two of the three largest assets in the estate — 98,454,570 intraday flow bars and 20,203,151 ticks — have never been consumed by any registered hypothesis at their native resolution. Every P-M hypothesis to date collapsed its instrument to one scalar per ticker-day before testing. Separately, the one asset that IS identity-immune (aggressor-side buy/sell) is the one that was never used structurally.

main_board.evidence: No board-classification field exists in any of the 82 production tables. Repo-wide grep for papan/pemantauan/board_type/main_board/development_board/DIRE/is_etf returns nothing.

papan_pemantauan_khusus.evidence: No special-monitoring field. This is the exact instrument HYP-PM-0008_SPEC section 20 blocker B4 requires and cannot obtain. PPK is a DIFFERENT market mechanism (full call auction, +/-10% symmetric above Rp10) so its members must be removed from any auto-rejection study, and they cannot be identified.
papan_pemantauan_khusus.note: IDX publishes the PPK list daily. Forward capture is straightforward; historical reconstruction back to 2023 is not, unless archived snapshots exist.

ipo_first_day.evidence: No listing-date table. idx_tickers.first_seen is 2026-04-24/27 for all 972 rows — it records when OUR scraper first saw the ticker, not the IDX listing date. A first-appearance proxy over ohlcv is computable but left-censored at the corpus start 2021-07-05.
ipo_first_day.recoverable: partially — first appearance in ohlcv is a lower bound on listing date for post-2021-07-05 listings only

BUT it is DERIVED by gap detection, not an authoritative IDX suspension feed: classification breakdown is data_gap=2,830 / suspension=359, i.e. 89% of rows are our own missing data rather than observed exchange suspensions.

suspension_status.recoverable: usable as a declared proxy today; an authoritative feed requires external acquisition

part3_capturability_legs.note: Mechanical/legal feasibility only. No return, cost, or profitability quantity was computed.

limit_down_continuation_short_leg.evidence: Capturing a predicted DOWNWARD continuation requires short exposure. LC-PM-0006 records IDX as order-driven with no designated market maker; DISCOVERY_2026-08-21_M2x_short_horizon section 7 records that IDX short-selling rules were 'not extractable from the official page fetched', and DISCOVERY_2026-08-21_M6_I1_price_limits excludes shorting as the capture leg (EX4-adjacent, 'IDX does not practically permit'). No borrow/short-availability data exists in any of the 82 tables.

limit_up_continuation_long_leg.evidence: LC-PM-0007 (Q4, J.Econometrics): at an upper-limit hit the queue is composed of buyers and a late arrival does not execute — 'the mechanism that creates the effect excludes you from it'.

queue_position.evidence: No order-book, queue-depth or order-event data exists. ZCODE_ALPHA_DISCOVERY_FAMILY_MAP section 6 lists order book as 'unavailable in market — blocked permanently'. ticks (20.2M rows, 2026-04-18..2026-09-14) carries price/volume/tick_type but no queue state.

late_arrival_eligibility.evidence: depends on queue position; same gap

t_plus_2_settlement.evidence: IDX regular market settles T+2; the SPEC's k=1 close-to-close horizon does not require intraday round-tripping or settlement netting. No held data contradicts this. Documentary basis: LC-PM-0006 market-design card.

short_selling_availability.evidence: No short-eligibility list, no borrow data, no fee data in any table. LC-PM-0009 notes the short-selling eligibility list was republished 2023-04-03 but it was never captured.

ordinary_board_constraints.evidence: board membership unavailable (part1); a PPK name trades by call auction and cannot execute a continuous-session strategy at all

auction_close_execution.evidence: stockbit_flow_bars ends at 16:14 with a structural gap at 15:50-15:59 (the pre-closing/closing auction window). The closing auction itself is not observable in any held table.

suspension_constraints.evidence: suspension_events plus session-calendar non-consecutiveness plus zero volume; declared as a proxy, not a measurement

part3_capturability_legs.summary: Of 9 legs: 1 CAPTURABLE, 1 CAPTURABLE-as-proxy, 2 NOT CAPTURABLE for structural reasons that no data acquisition would change, and 5 UNKNOWN-DATA-MISSING. The two NOT CAPTURABLE verdicts are the ones that bind HYP-PM-0008, and they are market-structure facts, not data gaps.

part4_intraday_flow.identity_status: IMMUNE. buy_lot and sell_lot are SEPARATE aggressor-side quantities that do not balance. FOUR_TEST_IDENTITY_AND_REGISTRY_AUDIT_2026-09-11 part D.2 independently verified this instrument is 'structurally immune' (BBCA 44.4M vs 63.9M shares; |NF| p50 = 0.175 — genuine variance). The all-broker-net identity that voided HYP-PM-0003, BFI-001's primary and C2 DOES NOT REACH THIS TABLE.
part4_intraday_flow.why_not_A: The CONTENT is dense and complete; the PROVENANCE does not exist. stockbit_flow_bars has no captured_at, no retrieval timestamp, no request parameters, no response hash, no completeness flag, and no raw payload. Both writers (stockbit_fetcher.py:789, tools/backfill_flow_bars.py:154) use INSERT OR REPLACE, so any re-fetch silently overwrites history in place and leaves no trace. The table cannot be proven PIT and cannot be deterministically reconstructed.
part4_intraday_flow.prospective_fix: docs/research_programs/P-M/prospective_capture/ — and the design is NOT novel: dataset_b's capture layer already implements exactly this pattern correctly (raw_responses with gzipped payloads, capture_manifest, capture_run_log with code_sha256). The fix is to replicate a proven in-repo pattern, not to invent one.

part6_information_loss.principle: Separate what was never collected from what was collected and then discarded.

chains.raw: broker_flow_b 1,518,727 broker rows / 30,877 ticker-day cells / 95 broker identities / median 47 brokers per cell
chains.materialization: per ticker-day counts of net-buying vs net-selling brokers
chains.feature: breadth imbalance scalar, then a +/-0.30-vs-trailing-median binary state
chains.tested: one daily cross-sectional state-contrast series, 329 daily observations
chains.discarded: broker IDENTITY entirely; per-broker magnitudes; the full distribution behind the count; all intraday timing (never held for broker data)

chains.raw: same 1,518,727 broker rows, plus ohlcv close x volume
chains.materialization: gross = sum of |value| per ticker-session; ADV20 = 20-session median traded value, shift(1)
chains.feature: intensity = gross/ADV20, then a binary state at >= 2.0
chains.discarded: everything that distinguishes one broker from another; the entire magnitude distribution above and below the 2.0 threshold; the sign/direction of each broker's participation; all intraday shape
chains.compression: 1,518,727 broker rows -> one binary flag per ticker-day

chains.raw: stockbit_flow_bars — 98,454,570 one-minute aggressor-side bars with SEPARATE buy_lot/sell_lot
chains.materialization: OFI_day = sum(delta) / sum(buy_lot + sell_lot), one scalar per ticker-day
chains.discarded: 335 bars per ticker-session collapsed to ONE number, then to ONE BIT. Intraday timing, shape, front/back-loading, within-day reversal, the buy/sell split itself, and buy_freq/sell_freq were all summed away.

genuinely_missing: broker identity at intraday resolution (not disclosed by IDX — permanent)
order book / queue depth / order events (unavailable in market — permanent)
board classification incl. Papan Pemantauan Khusus (exists at IDX, never captured — fixable prospectively)
short-sell eligibility and borrow (exists at IDX, never captured — fixable prospectively)
authoritative suspension feed (exists at IDX, only a derived proxy held)
the two ARB decrees as documents (exist, class B, lawful channel proven)
held_but_discarded: 98,454,570 intraday flow bars — never consumed at native resolution by ANY registered hypothesis
20,203,151 ticks (2026-04-18..2026-09-14, 868 tickers) — consumed only by the VPIN path, never by a registered P-M hypothesis

buy_freq / sell_freq on the intraday table — note broker_flow.freq is UNKNOWN/FORBIDDEN, but these are a DIFFERENT field from a different endpoint and were the trusted reference used to condemn broker_flow.freq
broker identity — 95 codes, present in every Dataset B cell, collapsed to counts (C3) or summed away (C7)
the magnitude distribution either side of every threshold C3/C7 binarized
corporate_action_events.raw_json and ~10,182 event rows not reached by the research path
bandar_detector.total_buyer/total_seller — the ONLY uncensored participation measure in the estate, VERIFIED, and unused by any registered hypothesis
part6_information_loss.verdict: Both causes are real, but they are not equal in size. The permanent unavailabilities are narrow and specific (intraday broker identity, order book, client identity). The discarded-information set is enormous and includes the single largest identity-immune asset in the estate.

stockbit_flow_empty_dates.detail: trade_date is NULL or '' — valid range otherwise 2025-01-02..2026-09-14

ohlcv_mixed_adjustment_basis.detail: A fractional close proves an in-place split adjustment was applied inside ohlcv. 14.5% of the universe carries one, while corporate_actions holds only 2,171 rows. DATASET_B_SEMANTIC_REGISTER_v1 already grades ohlcv.close/volume 'VERIFIED WITH DEFECT'; this quantifies it for the first time. Any CA-based exclusion is blind to adjustments with no matching CA row — this is exactly how the WICO 2023-07-20 anomaly evaded exclusion in the R3 boundary audit.
